name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- September 7, 2026
- Edit with local proxies, Work Local, and Use server originals now live together as one group — they're the same choice, so they read as one now instead of being split across two separate places on the panel
- Sync Proxies and Work Local share one progress view — same ring, same file counter, same Cancel — instead of two different-looking progress screens
- adds a running "X of Y files" count under the current file name during both proxy syncing and Work Local
- Change cache location is disabled while a sync or Work Local run is in progress
- Cancel now returns you straight to the three buttons instead of leaving the screen on a "cancelled" message
- long project names no longer crowd out the connection badge — they truncate with the full name available on hover
- use **Edit with local proxies** for normal lightweight editing
- use **Work Local** when you want the whole project on your computer for full local-disk speed
- use **Use server originals** before handing the project to another editor or computer
